releases.summary: A wider settings sidebar.
details: The settings sidebar is wider (420 px, never more than 92% of the window), so options and add-on settings fit more easily.

releases.summary: The new tab page title is "New Tab" again.
details: The browser tab title is back to "New Tab". The extension itself is still named Ampere.

releases.summary: Three more add-ons: Exam Master, GitHub Activity and Wallpapers.
details: Exam Master: choose exam board (Cambridge, OxfordAQA, Edexcel, AQA, OCR), level, subject, year, session and paper step by step, then open a search for that exact paper. Cambridge papers get their exact reference, like 0580/12/M/J/23.
GitHub Activity: a public profile's recent activity and repositories. Only the username is sent to GitHub.

Wallpapers: a fresh background from NASA APOD, Wikipedia's picture of the day, the Art Institute of Chicago, Picsum or Unsplash (with your own free key), changed daily or on every tab, with the picture credit shown.
Add-ons can now set the background picture.

releases.summary: Ampere: four new add-ons, developer tags on news, and add-on data in backups.
details: The extension is now called Ampere.
New add-ons (Settings → Add-ons): Notes, To-do & Focus (pin sticky notes to the page), Planner (day, week and month), Break Reminder, and Extra Themes with eighteen colour presets.
News posts can show their developer as a tag with their GitHub username and profile picture.
Settings → Backup now includes notes, plans and other add-on data.
Community add-ons and news can be contributed on GitHub: see CONTRIBUTING.md.

releases.summary: Weather and Prayer Times buttons appear only when in use.
details: The "Show on page" switches for the Weather and Prayer Times buttons are gone: the Weather button shows when Weather is on, and the Prayer Times button shows when that add-on is installed.
The highlighted next prayer now has room on both sides, so its text no longer touches the edge.

releases.summary: Add-ons, starting with Prayer Times, and news pictures that fit the card.
details: New Add-ons section in Settings. An add-on is downloaded into an addons folder inside your extension folder only when you press Install, checked, and saved. Nothing is downloaded if you never install one.

First add-on: Prayer Times. A button next to Weather opens a card with today's prayer times, the next prayer with a countdown, and the Hijri date. Choose a city, calculation method, Asr school and 12/24-hour times in Settings.
News pictures now use the full width of the card at their natural height, and are only cropped when they are taller than the limit.

releases.summary: Safer staged updates, one shared gradient engine, default shortcuts, and a tidier weather.
details: Updates now save the whole new version in one file (new-version.json), check it, and only then replace the installed files. If anything fails the old version stays untouched, and an interrupted update is finished the next time the page opens.
The gradient engine is now the shared ElectronCSS/CubicGradient.js: the updater copies it in, and the NewTab folder no longer keeps its own copy.
New installs start with GitHub and ProElectricCoder shortcuts. They never trigger the DeepBlue IDE suggestion; only a GitHub shortcut you add yourself does.
The weather summary in the middle of the page is gone: weather lives only in the card next to the News button.
Search engine and news icons load straight from Google's favicon service, with rounded corners and no white box.
Settings now has a Feedback line with an email address for bug reports and suggestions.

releases.summary: Weather card, search engine icons, and a scrollable engine menu.
details: New weather button next to the News button opens a weather card: current conditions, feels-like, humidity, wind, sunrise and sunset, the next 8 hours and a 7-day forecast.
Search engines now show their site icons (a coloured letter badge appears if an icon can't load).
The search engine menu now fits the screen and scrolls instead of running off the bottom.
The engine list in Settings has the custom scrollbar too.
Show on page now has separate switches for the weather summary and the weather button.

releases.summary: Weather, more search engines, show/hide switches, settings backup and a steadier shortcuts grid.
details: Weather widget (off by default): current conditions and a 3-day outlook from Open-Meteo, with °C/°F. Set your city in Settings → Weather.

Search engines: DuckDuckGo, YouTube, GitHub, Wikipedia, Brave, Reddit, Stack Overflow, Google Maps and Amazon join Google and Bing. Type a shortcut and a space (like “yt cats”) to use one for a single search, or add your own engines in Settings.
New Show on page switches for the logo, clock, date, weather, search bar, shortcuts and News button.
Export and import all shortcuts, settings, search engines and your chosen picture as one file (Settings → Backup).
Shortcuts grid: dragging no longer makes a scrollbar flash up, and the grid scrolls when you drag near its edge.
Slimmer custom scrollbars in Settings, News and the shortcuts grid.

releases.summary: World News topic filter, using the topics the news sites provide.
details: World News shows topic buttons built from the categories each news site attaches to its headlines (only when the site provides them).
The News button now appears even when the dev news file can't be loaded.

releases.summary: Preset backgrounds, news source logos, and a CNN feed fix.
details: Six built-in backgrounds drawn with CSS (Aurora, Neon night, Sunset, Ocean, Forest, Graphite) under Settings → Background → Picture.
Each news source now shows its logo next to its name in Settings and in the World News panel.
The news relay now tries several CNN feed addresses, since CNN's server sometimes closes the connection.

releases.summary: Changelog in Settings, 11 world news sources with a switch each, picture backgrounds and a light theme.
details: Settings → About → Changelog lists every version at any time.
World News now offers BBC, CNN, Al Jazeera, Arab News, The Guardian, The New York Times, NPR, Sky News, CBS News, DW and France 24, each with its own switch (BBC, CNN and Al Jazeera start on).
Backgrounds can now be a picture: choose a file or paste an https:// address, with a dim slider to keep text readable.
New Theme setting (Dark, Light or Match system) restyles the clock, search bar, shortcuts, settings and news panels. An untouched default gradient switches to a light one in the light theme.

releases.summary: World News now loads through our own relay, fixing the CORS errors.
details: World News headlines are fetched through proelectriccoder.pages.dev, which adds the permissions browsers require.
The extension no longer asks for permission to read the news sites directly.

releases.summary: World news from BBC, CNN and Al Jazeera; pictures in news and suggestion cards; ChatRooms renamed.
details: News posts and suggestion cards can include an optional image (DeepBlue IDE's card now shows its preview picture).
The chat project is now called ChatRooms in news and suggestions.
New World News tab (off by default, turn on in Settings → News): headlines loaded directly from BBC News, CNN and Al Jazeera, with a filter per source.
The News panel is now split into Dev News and World News.
Adds permission to read those three news feeds (no new files).

releases.summary: New News panel with updates from my other projects, plus project suggestions.
details: A News button (top-left) lists the latest updates from ChatRooms and other projects.

Suggestion cards can appear based on your shortcuts, e.g. DeepBlue IDE for coding sites, ChatRooms for messaging apps and SEP Encryptor for encryption sites. Matching happens only in your browser and cards can be dismissed.
News and suggestions can be turned off under Settings → News.

releases.summary: Tab icon follows the logo colours; update notes stack per version.
details: The browser tab icon now takes the logo's outline and fill colours.
When several updates land together, Details lists each one with its own step (e.g. v1.4.3 → v1.5.0, then v1.5.0 → v1.5.1).
Updates now read their file list from Changelog.json, so future releases can add new files safely.

releases.summary: Fixed buttons, favicon-cache icons, logo colours, changelog viewer.
details: Fixed the search-engine dropdown, which closed itself in the same click that opened it.
Shortcut URLs typed without https:// (e.g. youtube.com) now open correctly.
Background colour pickers now preview live while you drag, instead of only when closed.
Shortcut icons now come from Chrome's own favicon cache instead of the DuckDuckGo service.
The icon URL field in the shortcut dialog is now tucked behind an "Advanced" button.
The logo's outline and fill colours can now be changed, or matched to the background gradient.
The update toast now shows a one-line summary with a Details button listing every change.
The "+" in the Add shortcut button is now exactly centred.

releases.summary: Background auto-update via chrome.runtime.reload() and improved link-folder UI.
File-based auto-update system using Updates.json and a stored folder handle.
Fixed the shortcuts grid not rendering; added safe JSON parsing.
Fixed shortcut menu button orientation and click propagation.
Fixed shortcut icon URL auto-populating incorrectly; added autocomplete=off.
Fixed search bar underline focus bug; separated script into NewTabJS.js.
Added gradient direction, power curve and smoothness controls.
